about: Retrieval evaluation for the RAG corpus from scripts/fetch_corpus.py (arXiv cs.IR abstracts, January to June 2025). Each question is answered by one abstract; chunk is that abstract's chunk ID. Questions were drafted by Claude from 40 randomly chosen abstracts (seed 7) and checked against each abstract's text. keywords: the answer counts as correct if it contains any of them (case-insensitive).

questions.question: Which benchmark covers more than 2,000 combinations of tasks, architectures, optimizers and language models for studying multi-step language model pipelines?
What offline reinforcement learning framework for recommender systems uses model uncertainty and decaying penalizers to keep the variety of states high?
In a multi-agent framework for attributed question answering, how much did combining sparse and dense retrieval improve Recall@20?
questions.answer: 12.5% over the best single retrieval model

questions.question: Which LLM recommendation framework merges a general 'base spirit' LoRA module with a domain-specific 'ingredient' LoRA module?
What approach removes ambiguity from user prompts by asking a structured series of clarification questions before producing a final solution?
Which auto-tuning system for recommendation value models aims to find a usable solution within two to three days?
Which LLM-based retriever is trained with bidirectional reinforcement learning to augment both the queries and the corpus documents?
Which procedure extends CRISP-DM with 'technical understanding' and 'implementation' phases and was applied to fuel efficiency in Danish public transport?
Which e-commerce query rewriting pipeline combines offline knowledge distillation with online reinforcement learning, using LLMs as simulated human feedback?
questions.answer: A hybrid RL-based query rewriting pipeline with a distilled LLM, evaluated on Amazon ESCI

questions.question: Which research challenges are identified for evidence retrieval when fact-checking scientific claims against full papers rather than abstracts?
questions.answer: Evidence-driven retrieval, time-aware retrieval with citation tracking, structured document parsing, complex scientific expressions, and credibility assessment

questions.question: Which theoretical model connects in-context-learning recommendation with large language models to gradient descent dynamics?
How many samples and asset classes are in the dataset built to study product bias in LLM investment recommendations?
What detection accuracy did a graph neural network that compares evidence graphs with claim graphs reach on out-of-context image-caption misinformation?
Which method speeds up LLM click-through-rate prediction with graph convolutional networks for retrieval and a multi-head early exit?
questions.answer: A RAG-enhanced LLM recommender with multi-head early exit

questions.question: How much more data-efficient were dialogue state tracking retrievers trained by scoring in-context examples for their combined effect?
What improvements on AlpacaEval2 and MixEval-Hard did an alignment method that treats LLM generation like a retriever-reranker system achieve?
Which four contrastive learning models were tested for robustness on medical image-report retrieval when parts of the images are occluded?
Which diffusion model treats multimodal knowledge graph completion as gradually generating the joint distribution of (head, relation) pairs and tail entities from noise?
Which framework finds weak and inactive users and serves them with in-context learning by an LLM to make top-k recommendation fairer across user groups?
questions.answer: A hybrid task allocation framework for efficient and responsible LLM adaptation

questions.question: Which generative ranking network duplicates a user's behaviour sequence into a real flow and a fake flow to be more efficient than Meta's HSTU?
Between 2000 and 2022, did German information retrieval researchers contribute mainly to TREC or to CLEF?
When many information retrieval systems are compared at once, which statistical test and correction kept Type I errors at the significance level with the best power?
Which review covers hashtag recommendation methods from frequency-based models to transformers?
questions.answer: A comprehensive review on hashtag recommendation

questions.question: Which social recommendation method denoises the social graph with low-rank SVD and uses mutual distillation to help cold users?
How many news articles about 2020 natural disasters and terrorist attacks were found by matching event fingerprints?
Which RAG framework lets users trade accuracy against retrieval cost with one interpretable control parameter, alpha?
questions.answer: A user-controllable RAG framework with two classifiers (Flare-Aug)

questions.question: What CHSH expectation values did a semantic Bell inequality test with LLM agents produce?
questions.answer: Averages from 1.2 to 2.8, some runs 2.3 to 2.4, above the classical limit of 2

questions.question: What inclusive replacement rate did a BERT model trained on gender-neutralised PubMed abstracts reach, compared with a model trained on the original text?
By how much did feature selection and serialization improve LLM extraction of patient data from electronic health record tables?
How many training instances does a process-reward method for agentic RAG need compared with Search-R1?
Which sequential recommendation framework uses GANs for data augmentation and graph contrastive learning on a global item relationship graph?
Which memory layer for AI agents, built on a temporal knowledge graph, scored 94.8% on the Deep Memory Retrieval benchmark?
How does eBay train relevance models for the keyphrases recommended to advertisers?
questions.answer: With LLM-as-a-judge used at scale as a proxy for seller judgment

questions.question: How much higher query throughput did new range retrieval algorithms for graph-based vector indices reach than a standard graph search and FAISS-IVF range search?
Which language model, when fine-tuned, agreed best with human assessors when filling unjudged holes in conversational search test collections?
Which Graph-RAG indexing framework builds a knowledge graph skeleton from key chunks plus a text-keyword bipartite graph to cut indexing cost?
Why should two-sided platforms such as video streaming avoid myopic-greedy recommendation policies?
questions.answer: They ignore population effects: viewers and providers benefit from each other's growth, so exposure should be spread among provider groups

questions.question: Which regression method replaces many data points with granular balls to cut the cost of support vector regression?
What gain on user active days did fine-grained time-aware interest modelling achieve in an online A/B test of a music app's recommendations?
Which collection unifies open-domain document visual question answering datasets for RAG over charts, tables and slides?
